title: The 10 Best Programmable Coffee Makers of 2026
h1: The 10 Best Programmable Coffee Makers of 2026
metaDescription: Our 10 picks for programmable coffee makers of 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at programmable coffee makers of 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Breville Precision Brewer Thermal
products.blurb: Key specs: SCAA certified, 12-cup thermal, 24-hour programmable.
strengths: SCAA certified with full programmable timer, the best combination of quality and scheduling
12-cup thermal carafe
Multiple brewing modes including Gold Cup, Fast, and Over Ice
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: OXO Brew 9-Cup
strengths: SCAA certified with programmable timer at a lower price than Breville
Rainshower head for even bed saturation

products.name: Hamilton Beach 12-Cup
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money

products.name: Mr. Coffee 12-Cup
strengths: Very affordable
Programmable delay start for morning coffee
12-cup glass carafe for households
Simple controls with pause-and-serve
limitations: Glass carafe on a hot plate can make coffee taste stewed over time

products.name: Cuisinart SS-15 12-Cup + Single Serve
products.blurb: Key specs: 12-cup + single serve, Programmable, Cuisinart.
strengths: Full carafe + single serve with programmable timer

products.name: Black+Decker 12-Cup Thermal Programmable
strengths: Thermal carafe keeps coffee warm without burning
Programmable timer
Large 12-cup capacity
Budget price for a thermal carafe model
limitations: Carafe can be awkward to pour and clean
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money

products.name: Zojirushi EC-YTC100XB 10-Cup Thermal
strengths: Stainless steel vacuum carafe keeps coffee hot for hours
Good brewing temperature for a mainstream maker
Removable water tank for easy filling
Zojirushi's reputation for durability

products.name: Moccamaster Cup One Thermal
products.blurb: Key specs: Single cup, SCAA certified, Thermal travel mug.
strengths: SCAA certified single-cup brewing into a thermal travel mug
Moccamaster quality for one person
limitations: Single cup only, not correct for multi-person households

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
